ns2:section.sectionText: A study of what makes organizations - corporate, non-profit, and government - sustainable. The course covers management, supply chains, business processes, value creation and efficiency. Junior or Senior standing required. This section will have 3 live (Elluminate)sessions on the following dates/times: Monday, Jan. 23, 6:30-8:30 pm CST Monday, Feb. 27, 6:30-8:30 pm CST Monday, Mar 5, 6:30-8:30 pm CST
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
